title: 第19章 家庭教师七第20章 Reborn番外

第19章 家庭教师七
张开五指伸向那天空中炫目的颜色，阳光穿过指缝流泻下来，在脸上洒下一片模糊的光晕，被摇晃的树影切割的明明灭灭。
律眯起眼睛，用着听不出情绪的声音喃喃自语。
“现在这样的生活…是真实的吗…”还是只不过是系统制造出来的，一个完美的幻境呢。
脑袋上啪的落下一只手，某个很是欠扁的声音响起来。
“你在偷懒吗？奈奈在找你呢。”
六道骸的声音带着别扭，却让本来有些不知所谓的律微微的笑起来。
“知道我在偷懒就不要叫我啊，你不是可以替我帮忙的嘛。”
某骸坚决不承认是在担心他，只是白了律一眼。
“真当我打杂的，小心我收拾你的那个废柴哥哥。”
律站起来拍了拍身上沾上的青草屑，伸了个大大的懒腰，看起来很是敷衍的道。
“知道了，”然后转身，“你也快来一起帮忙吧，骸。”
六道骸静静地看着微笑的律，也勾起一抹笑容。
“好。”
日子再度恢复了平静，律想了想这乱七八糟的剧情，叹了口气。自己就算知道原著的剧情，但是那和这个世界的发展真是没有太大的相似之处啊。
那么，律无所谓的耸耸肩，就走一步看一步好了。
律步行走在并盛大街上，在想哪一家超市有卖比较便宜又新鲜的水果，毕竟在日本买水果真是价格不低呢，比起c国来说，那价格高的让律每次买水果时都觉得肉疼。
正当他有些神游天外的时候，一个小小的身影跌跌撞撞的从拐角冲出来，正好和来不及躲避的律撞了个满怀。
虽说是他撞上了自己，但大概是因为那人只是个孩子，所以由于身高悬殊，律倒是没什么事儿，反而是他自己因为反作用力不可控制的向后倒去。
条件反射的拉住他，一用力孩子总算是没有摔倒，而是顺势跌在了律的怀里。

看着怀中的银色小脑袋，律歪歪头，啊咧，还是个外国小孩儿？
就这一会儿的功夫，律还没来得及松开他，就敏锐的察觉到身后传来的刀风，敏捷的一闪，身后袭来的刀扑了个空。
律抬眼看向来人，那一头耀眼而醒目的银色长发和手中拿着的双刃剑让律不可抑制的嘴角抽搐。
出来买个水果都能碰到s娘，律深深感叹自己的磁场真是欠打。
斯库瓦罗眯眼看着这躲过自己一击的少年，虽说刚刚并没有用上全力，但是能躲开他的攻击，怕是也不是普通人了。
扯着大嗓门，斯库瓦罗提出警告，如果是无关人士那么他也就放他一条生路。
“这小子是彭格列暗杀部队要处理的人，识相的话就赶快闪开，把你看到的忘了。我可以不杀你，少年。”
律很清楚斯库瓦罗的实力和丰富的战斗经验，自己就算能撑一会儿也绝对不是他的对手。
本想着多一事不如少一事的律刚想答应下来，系统的声音却响了起来。
“玩家触发随机任务，保护这个男孩。任务成功获得与动物交流的能力，失败每天只清醒一小时。”
与动物交流的能力？律眼中划过一丝兴味。系统倒是出手越来越大方了呢。
律低头摸了摸孩子的头，柔声道，“你有地方去吗？有的话就先走，这里有我。”
银发的孩子猛地抬起头，带着一脸的不可思议。
“你要帮我？你不是他的对手的。”
“而且…我已经没有地方可去了。”
律想了想道，“那你先在旁边找个安全的地方，等我一会儿，我带你回家。”
男孩如紫水晶般绚丽的眼瞳微微放大，沉默了的看着他，终是点了点头。
看着男孩向后跑去，斯库瓦罗就要追上去，却被少年笑眯眯的拦住。
“抱歉，那个男孩是我想要保护的人，我不能让你走。”
斯库瓦罗危险的眯了眯眼，“我给过你机会了，既然你这么不识好歹，我就连你也一块儿杀了吧！”

说着手中的刀迅速的向他挥过来。
“锵！”
斯库瓦罗惊讶的看到自己的剑上竟不知怎么被一株藤蔓缠住了，一用力将藤蔓割断，却见周围的植物竟像是活了过来，随着少年的召唤而扑了过来。
该死的，这是怎么回事？
是幻觉吗？
不，不对。
斯库瓦罗一边躲闪着抽来抽去的树枝，一边小心着速度奇快且如刀一般锋利的树叶，由于数量太多而自己的剑也被源源不断的藤蔓缠住，无法施展，竟也不可避免的被划伤了几个地方。
再看看不远处的少年，他甚至都没能接近他！
该死的，这里到处都是植物，这样下去自己也伤不了他，更别说找到那个小鬼了。
这到底是什么见鬼的战斗方式！
斯库瓦罗郁闷的低咒，咬咬牙抽身退出十几米外。
扯大嗓门撂下一句，“你给我等着！”斯库瓦罗几个闪身迅速离开了这里。
律有些可惜的看着斯库瓦罗消失的方向，他还想多练练这个技巧问题呢，竟然就跑了…
不过，这个能力真是意外的好用呢。能看到s娘落跑的场面，真是————
爽、歪、歪。
笑眯眯的回头找那个银发的小鬼，然后上去，扑————
“走吧，我们回家。”
牵起男孩的手，律温柔的揉揉那一头异常柔软的银发，舒服的眯起了眼睛。
男孩听到律温柔的说我们回家的时候，一直带着防备的表情竟不自觉的软了下来。
感受着自己头顶上轻柔而亲昵的动作，男孩紫水晶一样透亮的眼睛闪过一丝依恋。

手心传来的温度让他不由自主的回握住，紧紧的，用力的。
仿佛在说着，再也不放开。
律牵着男孩慢慢的走在回家的路上，夕阳并不刺眼的阳光暖暖的洒在一大一小的两个人身上，在两人身后拖出长长的影子。
“呐，我叫律，泽田律。你叫什么名字？”
男孩在心里默念着律的名字，良久，清澈而带着一丝稚嫩的声音响起。
“白兰。杰索。”
笑眯眯，白兰童鞋真是萌物，扑倒蹭~
现在白兰并不应该是这个年纪，亲们就忽视这个问题吧，情节需要...

Chapter 19 Tutor 7
He opened his five fingers and stretched out towards the dazzling colors in the sky. The sunlight streamed down through the gaps between his fingers, casting a blurry halo on his face, cut off by the swaying shadows of the trees.
Ritsu narrowed his eyes and murmured in a voice with no discernible emotion.
"Is life like this now... real..." Or is it just a perfect illusion created by the system?
A hand slapped down on his head, and a loud voice sounded.
"Are you lazy? Nana is looking for you."
Liu Daogui's voice was awkward, but it made Lu, who was a little confused at first, smile slightly.
"Don't call me if you know I'm lazy. You can help me, right?"
Mouzui firmly refused to admit that she was worried about him, and just rolled her eyes at Lu.
"If you really treat me as a handyman, be careful of that good-for-nothing brother I deal with."
Lu stood up, patted the grass clippings on his body, stretched out, and said in a very perfunctory manner.
"I got it," and then turned around, "Come and help me too, Mukuro."
Liu Daogui looked at the smiling law quietly and also evoked a smile.
"Okay."
The days became calm again. Ritsu thought about the messy plot and sighed. Even if I know the plot of the original work, it is really not very similar to the development of this world.
Then, Lu shrugged indifferently and just took it one step at a time.
Lu was walking on Bingsheng Street, wondering which supermarket sells cheaper and fresher fruits. After all, buying fruits in Japan is really expensive. Compared with country C, the prices are so high that Lu feels pain every time he buys fruits.
Just when he was in a daze, a small figure stumbled out of the corner and bumped right into Lu, who had no time to escape.
Although he bumped into him, it was probably because the person was just a child, so due to the height difference, Ritsu was fine. Instead, he fell backwards uncontrollably due to the reaction force.
She grabbed him reflexively, and with a strong effort, the child finally didn't fall, but fell into Lu's arms.
Looking at the little silver head in his arms, Lu tilted his head, ah, is he still a foreign child?
In this moment, before Ritsu could let go of him, he was keenly aware of the wind of the sword coming from behind him, and with a quick dodge, the sword that came behind him flew away.
Lu raised his eyes to look at the person coming. The dazzling and eye-catching long silver hair and the double-edged sword in his hand made Lu's mouth twitch uncontrollably.
Every time he went out to buy some fruit, he would bump into S's wife. Lu deeply lamented that his magnetic field was really in need of beatings.
Scuvarro squinted at the young man who had dodged his attack. Although he had not used all his strength just now, he was probably not an ordinary person if he could dodge his attack.
With a loud voice, Scuvarro warned that if it was an unrelated person, he would let him live.
"This kid is the person that Vongola's assassination team wants to deal with. If you know his identity, get out of the way and forget what you saw. I don't have to kill you, young man."
Ritsu is very aware of Scuvarro's strength and rich combat experience. Even if he can hold on for a while, he will definitely not be his opponent.
Just as Lu was about to agree, thinking that doing more would be better than doing less, the system's voice rang.
"The player triggers a random mission to protect the boy. If the mission is successful, he will gain the ability to communicate with animals. If he fails, he will only be awake for one hour every day."
The ability to communicate with animals? A trace of interest flashed in Lu's eyes. The system is becoming more and more generous.
Lu lowered his head and touched the child's head, and said softly, "Do you have somewhere to go? If so, go first. I'm here."
The silver-haired child suddenly raised his head, with a look of disbelief on his face.
"You want to help me? You are no match for him."
"And...I have no placeBut gone. "
Lu thought for a while and said, "Then you find a safe place nearby, wait for me for a while, and I will take you home. "
The boy's brilliant amethyst-like pupils dilated slightly, he looked at him silently, and finally nodded.
Seeing the boy running backwards, Scuvarro was about to catch up, but was stopped by the young man with a smile.
"I'm sorry, that boy is the one I want to protect, and I can't let you go. "
Scuvarro narrowed his eyes dangerously, "I gave you a chance. Since you are so ignorant, I will kill you too! "
As he spoke, he quickly swung the knife in his hand towards him.
"Qiang! "
Scuvarro was surprised to see that his sword was somehow entangled with a vine. He cut the vine with force and saw that the surrounding plants seemed to come alive and pounced upon the boy's call.
Damn, what's going on?
Is it an illusion?
No, that's not right.
While dodging the branches that were being pulled back and forth, Scuvarro was careful of the leaves that were extremely fast and as sharp as knives. Because there were too many of them, his sword was entangled in a steady stream of vines and could not be used. Unavoidably, it was scratched in several places.
Looking at the young man not far away, he couldn't even get close to him!
Damn it, there are plants everywhere here, and I won't be able to hurt him at this rate, let alone find the kid.
What the hell kind of fighting method is this!
Scuvarro cursed depressedly, gritted his teeth and retreated more than ten meters away.
He shouted in a loud voice, "Wait for me!" "Scuvarro quickly left here in a few flashes.
Lu looked at the direction in which Scuvarro disappeared with some pity. He wanted to practice this technical problem more, but he ran away...
However, this ability is surprisingly useful. Being able to see S’s wife running away is really————
Cool, crooked, crooked.
With a smile, he looked back to find the silver-haired kid, then went up and pounced————
"Come on, let's go home. "
Holding the boy's hand, Lu gently rubbed the unusually soft silver hair and narrowed his eyes comfortably.
When the boy heard Lu gently saying that we were going home, his defensive expression softened unconsciously.
Feeling the gentle and intimate movements on his head, the boy's amethyst-like eyes flashed with a trace of attachment.
The warmth from the palm of his hand made him involuntarily hold it back, tightly and forcefully.
As if saying, never let go.
Lu led the boy and walked slowly on the way home. The sunset, which was not dazzling, shone warmly on the two people, one big and one small, dragging long shadows behind them.
"Now, my name is Ritsu, Ritsu Sawada. May I have your name? "
The boy muttered Ritsu's name silently in his heart, and for a long time, a clear and childish voice sounded.
"Bai Lan. Jesso. "
With a smile on her face, Bailan’s children’s shoes are really cute, so throw them down and rub them~
Bai Lan shouldn't be this age now, so please just ignore this issue. The plot requires...
